reason: Rule 2: Wikivoyage's only draw is walks around a resort-occupied island; no named trail or public sight.

name: Yanuya

name: Modriki
reason: Rule 3: Modriki is the same Cast Away island as Monuriki (alternate spelling in Wikivoyage's island list); duplicate.
objection: Wikivoyage mentions it separately for beaches and snorkelling, but it is the same place.

name: Malolo Lailai
reason: Rule 1-2: no visitor source gives a draw; re-looked at Wikivoyage, which lists only the island name, and Musket Cove is a marina resort.
objection: Many yachts and day trips go there; evidence is lacking.

name: Sunset Beach (Mana Island)
reason: Rule 3: a beach feature of Mana Island, mentioned only in passing in the Mana listing.
objection: Sunset Beach is named for its views and snorkelling.

name: The Supermarket
reason: Rule 1-2: Wikivoyage names this shark dive site close to Mana as one of the best dives; dive sites with a guide source may be kept.
objection: Single mention; diver-only, requires an operator; no coordinates.

name: Serenity Island
reason: Rule 2: only a Sleep listing with no description; a resort islet.

name: Navadra

name: Namotu Island

name: Tavarua Island
reason: Rule 2: private resort island; guests only. The surf wave Cloudbreak is judged separately.

name: Cloudbreak

name: Wilkes Passage
